findings.issue: This is the review copy of the gap L4-6 found in the research loop-protocol. The Expansive Depth Frontier paragraph says only that 'the seed step prints the derived budget'. It never names step_frontier_budget, the step that runs `frontier-admit.cjs budget --target review` and writes the derived maxIterations into deep-review-config.json (deep-review.yaml:930-943). It also leaves out that the step runs only when max_iterations_source is 'default', and that it is skipped on an extension and on a fan-out lineage (deep-review.yaml:932-933). The seed command only reports the budget on stderr (frontier-admit.cjs:1153). The config write is done by writeSeedBudget (frontier-admit.cjs:435-451). An operator who reads this paragraph cannot tell which step changes the config's maxIterations. This repo's own deep-review/references/state/state-format.md:75 does name step_frontier_budget as a config writer.

findings.issue: This is the review copy of the gap L4-1 found in the research state-format. The doc gives the reducer's projection as `registry.frontier`: nodes, stats, budget, activeNodeId and activeNextDimension. The review reducer also skips a frontier-nodes.jsonl row it cannot parse. It adds a `warnings` array to the projection when it skips one, and prints each skipped row on stderr as `[deep-review] warning: skipped <file> line <n>: <error>`. Neither the shape given here nor the Frontier Node Store paragraph above it says that a torn row is skipped and reported. The code comment points out that this warning is the only trace left when the torn row was the node's only row.
